capital.evidence_quote: Kingston is the capital and largest city of Jamaica

currency.evidence_quote: The Jamaican Dollar (JMD) is the official currency; US dollars are accepted widely in tourist areas

sources.title: Office of the Prime Minister of Jamaica

timezone.evidence_quote: Jamaica observes Eastern Standard Time UTC-5 year-round with no daylight saving time

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage in Jamaica is 110V nominal single-phase alternating current

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Jamaica operates an alternating electrical grid frequency of 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall sockets across Jamaica utilize North American Type A and grounded Type B plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 119 for emergency police assistance across Jamaica

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Wellness of Jamaica

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 110 for emergency ambulance and fire rescue services in Jamaica

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 110 for Jamaica Fire Brigade emergency response

general.evidence_quote: 119 acts as the primary emergency operator contact point

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist courtesy officers and specialized JCF resort patrols operate across Montego Bay and Ocho Rios

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Montego Bay, Negril ve Ocho Rios tatil köyleri güvenlidir; Kingston ve kırsal kenar mahallelerde dikkatli olunmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Resort areas like Montego Bay and Negril are secure; avoid certain high-crime downtown Kingston areas.
advisory_headline.de: Resortgebiete wie Montego Bay und Negril sind sicher; bestimmte Stadtteile von Kingston meiden.
advisory_headline.ru: Курортные зоны Монтего-Бей и Негрил безопасны; избегайте неблагополучных районов Кингстона.
advisory_headline.es: Las zonas de resorts como Montego Bay y Negril son seguras; evite barrios periféricos de Kingston.

regional_warnings.area: Downtown Kingston (West Kingston, Trench Town, Denham Town)
regional_warnings.reason: Gang violence and elevated violent crime rates; avoid non-essential night visits.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Jamaica measure approximately 43.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Jamaica reach 68.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: All inbound air passengers must complete the online Jamaica C5 Immigration and Customs Form prior to landing. Flow and Digicel provide 4G/LTE prepaid tourist eSIMs with reliable resort corridor coverage.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Submission of the online C5 immigration and customs declaration is mandatory

tr.conditions: Türkiye Cumhuriyeti umuma mahsus, hususi ve hizmet pasaportu hamilleri turistik amaçlı seyahatlerde 90 güne kadar vizeden muaftır. Online C5 formu zorunludur.

source.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency of Jamaica (PICA)

us.conditions: US citizens can enter Jamaica visa-free for tourism or business stays of up to 90 days with confirmed return tickets.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not need a visa for tourist visits of up to 90 days in Jamaica.

gb.conditions: British citizens do not require a visa to visit Jamaica for tourism stays of up to 90 days.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать на Ямайку без визы на срок до 90 дней в течение одного календарного года.

dos.title: Fill the online C5 form before boarding
dos.description: Complete the digital C5 card on enterjamaica.com before arriving at the airport to breeze through customs.

dos.title: Use red-plate licensed taxis (JUTA)
dos.description: Always choose taxis with red license plates ('PPV' - Public Passenger Vehicle) or JUTA tour operator shuttles.

dos.title: Try Jamaican Jerk Chicken and patties
dos.description: Savor authentic jerk chicken cooked over sweet pimento wood at Boston Bay or Scotchies.

donts.title: Don't wear camouflage clothing
donts.description: Wearing military camouflage clothing or accessories is strictly illegal for civilians in Jamaica.

donts.title: Don't accept unsolicited street guides
donts.description: Politely decline persistent street touts offering unofficial tours around beaches and craft markets with a firm 'No, thank you'.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10-15% is customary in sit-down restaurants and for tour drivers; all-inclusive resorts may have differing tip policies.
